notes.title: COPY SNIPER MECHANIC, NEW LEVEL (3-5), NEW ANIMATIONS AND MORE!
notes.content:
Patch Notes Demo 1.60

🆕 NEW STUFF 🆕 

-New Copy Sniper Mechanic!

-New level 3-5.

-Added animations (bruh).

-New obstacles for Stage 3 Part 2 levels and beyond.

-Added camera shake toggle.

-Added invert Y axis toggle. 



⛏️  CHANGES ⛏️ 

-Leaderboards now load page by page.

-Changed end portal shader a little.





⚒️  BUG FIXES ⚒️

 -Fixed localization for Russian and French.

-Fixed some UI bugs.

-Fixed Any% lb arrow not working.

-Fixed Any% PB's uploading bug (Sometimes it didn't upload to lb when u PB'd).

notes.title: NEW MECHANIC, INPUT OVERLAY AND MORE!
notes.content:
Patch Notes Demo 1.40

🆕 NEW STUFF 🆕 

-New Stage 3 Mechanic involving Tracking and Rail Grinding!
-Stage 3 added with 8 levels (only 1 level available in DEMO).
-New special obstacle “Star Dodecahedron”.
-Input Overlay Toggle added, it will be displayed always on replays.

⛏️  CHANGES ⛏️ 

-New laser beam effect when shooting.

⚒️  BUG FIXES ⚒️

-Fixed speed booster trigger for both blue and white speedpads.

notes.title: NEW RANKS, ANY% LBS AND MORE!
notes.content:
Patch Notes Demo 1.36

🆕 NEW STUFF 🆕 

-Any% Leaderboards added to every level.
-New “Secret Ranks” beyond SS.
-Remaked level 1-3 (new lbs).
-Remaked level 1-4 (new lbs).
-Removed camera clamp, aka u can do flips now.
-New toggle option: Reset Level On Miss.
-Added local and global try counter per level.
-Added visual effect when collecting extras (0.5 secs speedboost effect).
-Added additional visual effects to antigravity.
-Now the player can walk on top of any wall, this also resets double jump.

⛏️  CHANGES ⛏️ 

-Stage 1 and 2 are now communicated with the arrow button on level select and “Next Level” button at level complete screen.
-Now you can move through level select with arrow keys and enter any level with enter.
-Now at PB the background particles in the LEVEL COMPLETE screen change to yellow.

⚒️  BUG FIXES ⚒️

-Near death visual effect fixed on the lava and added on level walls.
-Fixed occlusion culling error on 2-1.
-Fixed some QoL UI issues.
-Fixed a bug where the missing sound effect clipped when spammed.
